recipes.title: Honey Garlic Salmon
recipes.description: Tender pan-seared salmon glazed with a sweet and savory honey garlic sauce. Ready in under 20 minutes.

ingredients.text: Salt and black pepper to taste
ingredients.item: Salt and black pepper to taste

steps.text: Pat salmon fillets dry with paper towels and season both sides with salt and black pepper.
In a small bowl, whisk together honey, minced garlic, soy sauce, and lemon juice. Set aside.
Heat olive oil in a large non-stick skillet over medium-high heat until shimmering.
Place salmon skin-side up in the pan. Sear for 4 minutes until golden, then flip.
Pour the honey garlic sauce over the salmon. Cook for another 3–4 minutes, spooning the sauce over the top as it thickens.
Remove from heat when salmon is opaque and flakes easily with a fork.
Garnish with fresh parsley and serve immediately with lemon slices.

recipes.author: Mariana K.

recipes.title: Spiced Lamb Tacos
recipes.description: Slow-braised spiced lamb in warm tortillas with quick-pickled onions, crema, and fresh cilantro.

ingredients.text: 700 g boneless lamb shoulder, cut into large chunks
ingredients.item: boneless lamb shoulder, cut into large chunks

steps.text: Quick-pickle the onion: combine sliced red onion, red wine vinegar, sugar, and a pinch of salt. Stir and leave for at least 30 minutes.
Mix all spices together. Pat lamb dry and season generously with the spice mixture.
Heat olive oil in a heavy oven-safe pot over high heat. Sear lamb chunks until browned on all sides, about 8 minutes total.
Add stock to the pot, scraping up any browned bits. Cover and braise in a 160°C oven for 1.5 hours until fork-tender.
Remove lamb, shred using two forks, then toss with the remaining braising liquid.
Warm tortillas in a dry pan or directly over a gas flame for 30 seconds each side.
Layer shredded lamb onto tortillas, add pickled onions, a drizzle of crema, and plenty of fresh cilantro.
Serve with lime wedges and hot sauce on the side.

recipes.author: Elena V.

recipes.title: Mango Coconut Chia Pudding
recipes.description: Creamy chia pudding made with coconut milk, layered with fresh mango purée and toasted coconut.

steps.text: In a bowl or jar, whisk together coconut milk, chia seeds, maple syrup, and vanilla extract.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 4 hours (or overnight), stirring once after 30 minutes to prevent clumping.
Blend one mango with lime juice until smooth to make the purée. Dice the remaining mango.
Layer the chia pudding in serving glasses with a spoonful of mango purée.
Top with diced mango pieces.
Sprinkle toasted coconut over each glass.
Garnish with fresh mint and serve chilled.

recipes.author: Yuki H.

recipes.title: Shakshuka
recipes.description: Eggs poached in a rich tomato and pepper sauce with cumin, paprika, and feta. A one-pan wonder.

ingredients.text: Fresh parsley or cilantro for garnish
ingredients.item: Fresh parsley or cilantro for garnish

steps.text: Heat olive oil in a large, deep skillet over medium heat. Add onion and bell pepper and cook for 7–8 minutes until softened.
Add garlic and cook for 1 minute. Stir in cumin, paprika, and chilli flakes.
Pour in crushed tomatoes. Add sugar, salt, and pepper. Stir to combine.
Simmer the sauce for 10 minutes until it thickens slightly.
Use a spoon to create 6 small wells in the sauce. Crack an egg into each well.
Cover the pan and cook on medium-low heat for 6–8 minutes, until whites are set but yolks are still runny.
Remove from heat and crumble feta generously over the top.
Garnish with fresh herbs and serve directly from the pan with crusty bread.

recipes.author: Omar A.

recipes.title: Classic Chicken Tikka Masala
recipes.description: Creamy, tomato-based curry with juicy marinated chicken. A community favourite that never disappoints.

ingredients.text: 700 g boneless chicken thighs, cut into chunks
ingredients.item: boneless chicken thighs, cut into chunks

ingredients.text: Fresh cilantro and basmati rice for serving
ingredients.item: Fresh cilantro and basmati rice for serving

steps.text: Combine yogurt, 1 tsp garam masala, turmeric, and a pinch of salt. Add chicken, coat well, and marinate for at least 30 minutes (overnight if possible).
Grill or broil chicken pieces on high heat until charred at the edges, about 10–12 minutes. Set aside.
Melt butter in a large heavy pan over medium heat. Add onion and cook until soft and golden, about 8 minutes.
Add garlic and ginger, stirring for 1–2 minutes until fragrant.
Stir in remaining spices (1 tsp garam masala, cumin, paprika) and cook for 30 seconds.
Pour in crushed tomatoes and simmer for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until slightly reduced.
Add the grilled chicken to the sauce. Stir in heavy cream and sugar. Simmer for 10 minutes.
Taste and adjust salt. Serve over basmati rice, topped with fresh cilantro.

recipes.author: Priya S.

recipes.title: Avocado Kale Salad
recipes.description: Fresh kale massaged with lemon dressing, topped with avocado, cherry tomatoes, and toasted seeds.

ingredients.text: 1 large bunch of kale, stems removed, leaves torn
ingredients.item: bunch of kale, stems removed, leaves torn

ingredients.text: Salt and black pepper to taste
ingredients.item: Salt and black pepper to taste

steps.text: Toast seeds in a dry skillet over medium heat for 2–3 minutes until golden. Set aside to cool.
Whisk together lemon juice, olive oil, honey, garlic, salt, and pepper in a large bowl.
Add kale to the bowl. Using clean hands, massage the dressing into the kale leaves for 2 minutes until they soften and darken.
Let the kale sit for 2–3 minutes to continue softening.
Add cherry tomatoes and avocado slices on top.
Scatter toasted seeds and shaved Parmesan over the salad.
Serve immediately or refrigerate (without avocado) for up to 4 hours.

recipes.author: Jordan T.

recipes.title: Triple Chocolate Lava Cake
recipes.description: Decadent molten chocolate cakes with a gooey center. Perfect for date night or special occasions.

ingredients.text: 115 g unsalted butter, plus extra for greasing
ingredients.item: unsalted butter, plus extra for greasing

ingredients.text: 2 tablespoons cocoa powder, plus extra for dusting
ingredients.item: cocoa powder, plus extra for dusting

ingredients.text: Vanilla ice cream or cream for serving
ingredients.item: Vanilla ice cream or cream for serving

steps.text: Preheat oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Butter 4 ramekins and dust with cocoa powder, tapping out excess.
Melt dark chocolate and butter together in a heatproof bowl over simmering water, stirring until smooth. Cool slightly.
Beat eggs, yolks, and sugar together with an electric mixer for 3–4 minutes until pale and thick.
Fold the melted chocolate mixture into the egg mixture gently.
Sift in flour and cocoa powder and fold until just combined.
Divide half the batter among ramekins. Place a few milk chocolate chips in the center of each, then top with remaining batter.
Bake for 10–12 minutes until the edges are set but the center jiggles slightly.
Rest for 1 minute, then run a knife around the edge and invert onto serving plates. Serve immediately with ice cream.

recipes.author: Claire B.

recipes.title: Smoky BBQ Pulled Pork
recipes.description: Slow-cooked pork shoulder with a bold smoky rub and tangy barbecue glaze. Fall-apart tender.

ingredients.text: Burger buns and coleslaw for serving
ingredients.item: Burger buns and coleslaw for serving

steps.text: Mix smoked paprika, brown sugar, garlic powder, onion powder, cumin, pepper, and salt together to form the dry rub.
Score the pork shoulder skin in a cross-hatch pattern and rub the spice mix all over generously. Cover and refrigerate overnight if possible.
Place pork in a slow cooker or Dutch oven. Pour apple cider vinegar around the base.
Cook on low for 8 hours (slow cooker) or in the oven at 150°C for 5–6 hours, covered, until the meat is extremely tender.
Remove pork and let it rest for 15 minutes.
Use two forks to shred the meat, discarding any large pieces of fat.
Toss shredded pork with BBQ sauce until fully coated. Warm through if needed.
Pile onto toasted burger buns with coleslaw and extra sauce.

recipes.author: Marcus W.

recipes.title: Zucchini Ricotta Flatbread
recipes.description: Crispy flatbread topped with whipped ricotta, thinly sliced zucchini, herbs, and chilli flakes.

steps.text: Preheat oven to 220°C. Place flatbreads on a baking sheet and brush lightly with olive oil.
In a bowl, whip ricotta with lemon zest, a squeeze of lemon juice, salt, and pepper until light and fluffy.
Toss zucchini slices with the remaining olive oil, garlic, salt, and pepper.
Spread ricotta generously over each flatbread.
Arrange zucchini slices on top, overlapping slightly.
Bake for 12–14 minutes until flatbread edges are golden and zucchini is tender.
Remove from oven and scatter chilli flakes, torn mint, and basil over the top.
Finish with a grating of Parmesan and an extra squeeze of lemon. Slice and serve.

recipes.author: Sofia L.

recipes.title: Tom Yum Soup
recipes.description: Aromatic Thai broth with lemongrass, galangal, lime, chillies, mushrooms, and fresh prawns.

ingredients.text: 1 litre good-quality chicken or prawn stock
ingredients.item: litre good-quality chicken or prawn stock

ingredients.text: 400 g large prawns, peeled and deveined
2 stalks lemongrass, bruised and cut into lengths
ingredients.item: lemongrass, bruised and cut into lengths

steps.text: Bring stock to a boil in a large pot. Add lemongrass, galangal, kaffir lime leaves, and chillies.
Simmer for 5 minutes to infuse the broth.
Stir in tom yum paste and let it dissolve fully.
Add mushrooms and cook for 3 minutes.
Season with fish sauce, lime juice, and sugar. Taste and adjust the balance — it should be hot, sour, salty, and slightly sweet.
Add prawns and cook for 2–3 minutes until just pink and cooked through.
Remove from heat. Remove lemongrass and galangal pieces before serving.
Ladle into bowls and garnish with fresh cilantro and extra lime wedges.

recipes.author: Aiden C.

recipes.title: Berry Overnight Oats
recipes.description: No-cook oats soaked overnight in oat milk, layered with mixed berries and a drizzle of maple syrup.

ingredients.text: 1 cup oat milk (or any milk of choice)
ingredients.item: oat milk (or any milk of choice)

ingredients.text: ½ cup mixed berries (blueberries, strawberries, raspberries)

steps.text: In a jar or airtight container, combine rolled oats, chia seeds, vanilla extract, a pinch of salt, and 1 tablespoon maple syrup.
Pour oat milk over the mixture and stir well to combine.
Cover and refrigerate overnight, or for at least 6 hours.
In the morning, give the oats a good stir. Add a splash more milk if you prefer a looser consistency.
Taste and adjust sweetness with remaining maple syrup.
Top with fresh mixed berries and a sprinkle of granola.
Drizzle extra maple syrup over the top and serve cold.

recipes.author: Nina P.

recipes.title: Mushroom Risotto
recipes.description: Velvety Arborio rice slowly cooked with mixed wild mushrooms, white wine, and fresh Parmesan.

ingredients.text: 500 g mixed mushrooms (porcini, shiitake, cremini), sliced
1.2 litres warm vegetable or chicken stock
ingredients.item: litres warm vegetable or chicken stock

steps.text: Heat olive oil and 1 tablespoon butter in a wide, heavy-bottomed pan. Add mushrooms in a single layer and cook undisturbed for 3 minutes. Season, toss, and cook 2 more minutes. Remove and set aside.
In the same pan, add remaining butter and cook onion over medium heat until soft, about 5 minutes. Add garlic and cook 1 minute.
Add Arborio rice and stir for 2 minutes until the grains turn translucent at the edges.
Pour in white wine and stir constantly until absorbed.
Add a ladle of warm stock and stir until absorbed. Continue adding stock one ladle at a time, stirring frequently, about 18–20 minutes total.
When rice is al dente and the mixture is creamy, remove from heat.
Stir in sautéed mushrooms, Parmesan, and remaining butter. Season generously with salt and pepper.
Cover and rest for 2 minutes. Serve in warmed bowls, topped with parsley and extra Parmesan.

recipes.author: Luca R.

recipes.title: Classic Fluffy Pancakes
recipes.description: Light, golden pancakes with a tender crumb. A comforting breakfast staple that's easy to whip up on any morning.

ingredients.text: Butter and maple syrup for serving
ingredients.item: Butter and maple syrup for serving

steps.text: In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
In a separate bowl, whisk together milk, egg, melted butter, and vanilla extract.
Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and stir gently until just combined — a few lumps are fine. Do not overmix.
Heat a non-stick skillet or griddle over medium heat. Lightly grease with butter.
Pour about ¼ cup of batter per pancake onto the skillet.
Cook until bubbles form on the surface and the edges look set, about 2–3 minutes. Flip and cook for another 1–2 minutes until golden.
Serve immediately with butter and maple syrup.

recipes.author: Chef Sample

recipes.title: Grilled Chicken Caesar Wrap
recipes.description: Tender grilled chicken, crisp romaine, shaved Parmesan, and creamy Caesar dressing wrapped in a warm flour tortilla.

steps.text: Season chicken breasts on both sides with garlic powder, smoked paprika, salt, and pepper.
Heat olive oil in a grill pan or skillet over medium-high heat. Cook chicken for 5–6 minutes per side until cooked through (internal temperature 74°C / 165°F).
Rest chicken for 5 minutes, then slice into thin strips.
Warm tortillas in a dry pan for 20–30 seconds each side.
Lay each tortilla flat. Drizzle 1 tablespoon Caesar dressing down the centre.
Layer with romaine, sliced chicken, and shaved Parmesan.
Fold in the sides and roll up tightly. Slice diagonally and serve with lemon wedges.

recipes.author: Chef Sample

recipes.title: One-Pan Lemon Herb Roast Chicken Thighs
recipes.description: Juicy, golden chicken thighs roasted with garlic, fresh herbs, and lemon over a bed of tender potatoes. Minimal cleanup, maximum flavour.

steps.text: Preheat oven to 200°C (180°C fan / 400°F).
In a large bowl, toss baby potatoes with 1 tablespoon olive oil, half the garlic, salt, and pepper. Spread in a single layer in a large roasting pan.
Pat chicken thighs dry with paper towels. In a small bowl, mix remaining olive oil, garlic, lemon zest, thyme, rosemary, onion powder, salt, and pepper.
Rub the herb mixture all over the chicken thighs, getting under the skin where possible.
Nestle the chicken thighs skin-side up on top of the potatoes.
Squeeze lemon juice over the entire pan.
Roast for 40–45 minutes until the chicken skin is deeply golden and an internal temperature of 74°C (165°F) is reached.
Rest for 5 minutes, then garnish with fresh parsley and serve.

recipes.author: Chef Sample

recipes.title: Classic New York Cheesecake
recipes.description: Dense, creamy New York-style cheesecake on a buttery graham cracker crust. Rich, smooth, and utterly indulgent.

ingredients.text: 200 g graham crackers or digestive biscuits, crushed
ingredients.item: graham crackers or digestive biscuits, crushed

ingredients.text: 900 g cream cheese, softened to room temperature
ingredients.item: cream cheese, softened to room temperature

steps.text: Preheat oven to 160°C (140°C fan). Grease a 23 cm springform tin.
Mix crushed biscuits with melted butter and press firmly into the base of the tin. Refrigerate for 15 minutes.
Beat cream cheese with an electric mixer until smooth. Gradually add sugar and flour, mixing on low.
Add vanilla and lemon zest. Beat in eggs one at a time on low speed until just combined — do not overmix.
Fold in sour cream.
Pour filling over the chilled base and smooth the top.
Bake for 55–65 minutes until the edges are set but the centre still has a gentle wobble.
Turn off the oven, crack the door open, and leave the cheesecake inside for 1 hour.
Refrigerate for at least 4 hours (or overnight) before slicing and serving.

recipes.author: Chef Sample

recipes.title: Crispy Baked Parmesan Zucchini Chips
recipes.description: Thinly sliced zucchini coated in seasoned Parmesan breadcrumbs and baked until irresistibly crisp. A light, crowd-pleasing snack.

steps.text: Preheat oven to 220°C (200°C fan). Line two baking sheets with parchment paper and lightly grease.
Slice zucchini into rounds about 5 mm (¼ inch) thick.
In a shallow bowl, combine Parmesan, breadcrumbs, garlic powder, Italian seasoning, salt, and pepper.
Dip each zucchini slice in beaten egg, letting the excess drip off, then coat in the Parmesan mixture, pressing gently to adhere.
Arrange in a single layer on the prepared baking sheets — do not overlap.
Bake for 20–22 minutes, flipping halfway through, until golden and crisp.
Serve immediately with marinara sauce for dipping.

recipes.author: Chef Sample

recipes.title: Tropical Mango Ginger Smoothie
recipes.description: A vibrant, refreshing blend of mango, pineapple, banana, and fresh ginger with coconut water. Naturally sweet and energising.

ingredients.text: Ice cubes (optional, for a thicker smoothie)
ingredients.item: Ice cubes (optional, for a thicker smoothie)

ingredients.text: Mango slices or mint for garnish
ingredients.item: Mango slices or mint for garnish

steps.text: Add frozen mango, pineapple, and banana to a blender.
Add grated ginger, coconut water, and lime juice.
Add honey if you prefer extra sweetness.
Blend on high until completely smooth, about 30–45 seconds.
Taste and adjust sweetness or lime juice as needed.
Add a handful of ice and blend again if you prefer a thicker, frostier texture.
Pour into glasses, garnish with mango slices or fresh mint, and serve immediately.

recipes.author: Chef Sample
